# Ecclesiastes Chapter 7 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 410r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ECC_007_page_001.jpg

---

**7:1** Better [tov] [is] a-name [shem] than-good [mi-shemen tov] oil [tov], and-the-day of-death [ha-mavet] than-the-day of-being-born [hivvaledo].

**7:13** Consider [re'eh] the-work [ma'aseh] of-God [ha-elohim]: for who [mi] can-make-straight [letiqqen] what he-has-made-crooked [she-ivveto]?

**7:29** See [re'eh], this only [levad] I-have-found [matsati]: that the-God made [asah] the-man [ha-adam] upright [yashar], but-they have-sought-out [biqqeshu] many [rabbim] inventions [chishshevonot].

---
## LOGOS Translation Notes

Formal rendering of Ecclesiastes 7, preserving Qohelet's distinctive voice — simultaneously philosophical and experiential.

*— LOGOS*
